title: Ant International-SRE Engineer (US)-Americas & EMEA Tech
description:
AUS Merchant Service.INC as known as Alipay that is committed to democratizing payment services and empowering people and businesses to join and thrive in the global economy. Alipay at its core is a group of engineers that are dedicated in building cutting edge, highly reliable, highly scalable and high throughput payment system. Here at Ant Group, you will have a positive impact to the world. You will learn and build the most exciting and most capable large-scale payment system with engineers like you with passion. A career at Alipay is more than just a job. It’s a chance to have broader knowledge and learn things from all aspects of how to make payments happen. At Alipay, we value personal growth and always set higher bar, encourage people to come out of comfort zone and make yourself a better you. You can expect to be constantly challenged with interesting technical problems. Our work environment is collaborative, innovative, results-driven, and completely focused on the customer.

AUS Merchant Service.INC North American Technology team is looking for a talented, creative, and passionate software engineer to help build a cutting-edge and innovative payment system to solve our merchant and consumer needs. As a self-motivated and enthusiastic member of our team, you will work with extremely talented peers in a fun environment building performance efficient payment authorization services that are highly scalable, configurable and available. You will be encouraged to innovate and move in a fast pace to deliver solution to our customers.

Responsibilities:
● Design and develop solutions to automate the technical operations of large-scale systems, and work closely with teams to improve stability from a Software Development Lifecycle perspective.
● Take the technical effort to strengthen payment system stability, which includes but not limited to the monitoring, logs, dashboard, diagnosis tools etc.; conduct usual drills and develop remedy plans to achieve fast service restoration, and take shifts to respond to production issues across regions.
● Define the indicators to evaluate the performance and runtime of the system to improve the observability, facilitating system development and trouble-shooting process; and, plan the system capacities according to business expansion and scheduled promotions.
● Analyze the production cases, such as performance bottleneck, to conclude the technical best-practices, taking the efforts to achieve the high-availability payment architecture.
● Designing and setting up new IDC; designing and implementing data protection plan to meet the standard requirement.

Qualifications:
● Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Computer Science-related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience; with 2 years of working experience in Internet industry preferred;
● Solid knowledge of Computer Science, and familiar with the principles of Operating System (Unix/Linux), Computer Storage, Computer Networking and other related principles.
● Software development experience in at least one programming language, such as Java/Python;
● The strong ability to resolve system problems, good communication skills and a sense of ownership.
● The experiences of Redis, MySQL, Nginx, Kubernetes, Docker/Containers, Function as a service, RPC Framework, and Service Mesh, etc.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is  $100,000-150,000.  Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Ant International and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant education or training.
Additional benefits for this role may include: company bonus,  401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits etc.

title: Ant International-Business Development Manage-U.S. Offline Payments
description:
About Antom
Antom is redefining how merchants accept payments and grow their businesses. As a global fintech leader under Ant International, we power commerce across 200+ markets, connecting merchants to consumers through unified payments, AI driven risk tools, and smart terminal solutions.
Now, we’re bringing that innovation to the United States.
We’re launching our U.S. offline payments channel, starting with SMB merchants in personal care (nail salons, spas) and auto repair services—two industries ready for modern, flexible, and global ready payment experiences. If you want to help build something new, bold, and high impact, this is your moment.

What Makes This Role Special
This isn’t just another sales job.
This is your chance to shape Antom’s U.S. market entry and bring a world class payments ecosystem—card acceptance, terminals, and Alipay+ mobile wallets—to underserved SMBs.
You’ll be the face of Antom in the field, the voice of the merchant inside the company, and the catalyst for our U.S. growth story.

What You Will Do
Drive Merchant Acquisition
• Travel within your territory to introduce Antom’s offline payments and terminal solutions to SMB merchants.
• Proactively source leads, build your pipeline, and convert merchants through a full end to end sales cycle.
• Conduct discovery, demos, pricing discussions, and contract negotiation with small business owners.
Act as a Strategic Consultant
• Tailor payment solutions that help nail salons, spas, and auto repair shops operate more efficiently and grow revenue.
• Educate merchants on Antom’s U.S. card acceptance, smart terminals, and global mobile wallet capabilities.
Build and Lead Referral Partnerships
• Develop and manage strategic referral relationships with:
• Independent Sales Organizations (ISOs)
• Independent Software Vendors (ISVs)
• Centers of Influence (COIs) such as local business associations, equipment suppliers, and community networks
• Create partner enablement strategies that drive consistent lead flow and merchant adoption.
• Represent Antom at partner events, trade shows, and local business gatherings.
Collaborate and Influence
• Work cross functionally with product, operations, and risk teams to ensure seamless merchant onboarding.
• Provide market intelligence and merchant feedback to shape Antom’s U.S. product roadmap.
Own Your Targets
• Meet and exceed monthly merchant acquisition, activation, and revenue goals.
• Maintain accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting.

What You Need to Have
• Experience in a quota driven, self sourced sales environment.
• Demonstrated success in cold calling, prospecting, and building your own pipeline.
• Strong communication and relationship building skills with SMB owners.
• Ability to thrive in a fast moving, startup like launch environment.
• High School Diploma or GED. Relevant collegiate degree preferred.

What Would Be Great to Have
• 3+ years of experience in payments, POS, merchant services, or SMB sales.
• Experience selling into personal care or auto service verticals.
• Experience developing referral partnerships with ISOs, ISVs, or COIs.
• Bachelor’s degree or military experience.
• Proven ability to design strategies that drive pipeline growth and revenue.

Compensation & Benefits
Antom offers a competitive and comprehensive compensation package, including:
• Competitive base salary
• Full medical benefits
• 401(k) plan
• Meal plan
• And much more

Why Join Antom
• Be part of the U.S. launch of one of the world’s most advanced payment platforms.
• Sell a differentiated solution combining card acceptance, smart terminals, and global mobile wallets.
• Work with a global fintech leader trusted by merchants in 200+ markets.
• Grow your career in a high impact role with massive upside.
• Join a team that values innovation, ownership, and merchant success.

The OTE of this position is around $150,000 - $300,000.

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base salary for the position across our US office locations. Individual pay is determined by a number of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and training.
